```{r theme_and_colors}
# Unified colorblind-friendly Technology Color Palette (ONT associated with Blue, PacBio with Orange)
color_palette <- c(
  "ONT_dRNA" = "#56B4E9",  # Soft Blue
  "dRNA_ONT" = "#56B4E9",  
  "Illumina" = "#252525",  # Neutral Dark Charcoal
  "ONT_cDNA" = "#4A5899",  # Sandy gold
  "cDNA_ONT" = "#4A5899",  
  "Iso-Seq"   = "#EE7B30",  # Orange
  "Kinnex"   = "#e31c93"   # PacBio pink
)


# Unified Nature-style theme for high-impact journals
theme_nature <- function(base_size = 6.5, base_family = "sans") {
  theme_classic(base_size = base_size, base_family = base_family) +
    theme(
      axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.35, colour = "black"),
      axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.35, colour = "black"),
      axis.title = element_text(size = base_size),
      axis.text = element_text(size = base_size - 0.7, color = "black"),
      legend.title = element_text(size = base_size - 0.3, face = "bold"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = base_size - 0.8),
      legend.key.size = unit(2.5, "mm"),
      legend.spacing.y = unit(0.5, "mm"),
      strip.text = element_text(size = base_size - 0.5, face = "bold", margin = margin(t = 2, b = 2)),
      plot.title = element_text(size = base_size + 0.5, face = "bold"),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "right",
      plot.tag = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold")
    )
}

theme_set(theme_nature())
```

```{r read_dataset_func}
read_dataset <- function(manifest_file, mapping_rules){
  input_files <- readLines(manifest_file, warn = FALSE)
  input_files <- trimws(input_files)
  input_files <- input_files[nzchar(input_files)]
  input_files <- input_files[!startsWith(input_files, "#")]
  print(input_files)
  if (length(input_files) == 0) {
    stop(paste("No input files found in manifest:", manifest_file))
  }
  
  missing_files <- input_files[!file.exists(input_files)]
  if (length(missing_files) > 0) {
    stop(paste("The following input files do not exist:\n", paste(missing_files, collapse = "\n")))
  }
  
  read_ujc_summary <- function(path) {
    data <- read.delim(path, sep = "\t", header = TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    required_columns <- c("experiment", "tool", "UJC", "n_transcripts")
    missing_columns <- setdiff(required_columns, colnames(data))
    if (length(missing_columns) > 0) {
      stop(paste("Missing columns in", path, ":", paste(missing_columns, collapse = ", ")))
    }
  
    data <- data[!is.na(data$UJC) & data$UJC != "", , drop = FALSE]
    data$experiment <- mapping_rules[data$experiment]
    data$tool <- case_when(
      data$tool == "flair"    ~ "FLAIR",
      data$tool == "isoquant" ~ "IsoQuant",
      data$tool == "kallisto" ~ "Kallisto",
      data$tool == "oarfish"  ~ "Oarfish",
      data$tool == "bambu"    ~ "Bambu",
      TRUE                    ~ as.character(data$tool)
    )
    data$group <- paste(data$experiment, data$tool, sep = "_")

    data
  }
  
  all_data <- do.call(rbind, lapply(input_files, read_ujc_summary))
  
  if (nrow(all_data) == 0) {
    stop("No UJC rows found across the provided files")
  }
  summary_table <- aggregate(
    n_transcripts ~ experiment + tool + group + UJC,
    data = all_data,
    FUN = sum
  )

  group_metadata <- data.frame(
    tool = unique(summary_table$tool), 
    technology = rep(unique(summary_table$experiment), each = 5)
  )
  group_metadata$set <- paste(group_metadata$technology, group_metadata$tool, sep = "_")
  group_to_cat = setNames(group_metadata$technology, group_metadata$set)
  summary_table <- summary_table[order(summary_table$experiment, summary_table$tool, summary_table$UJC), ]
  ujcs <- sort(unique(summary_table$UJC))
  
  presence <- data.frame(UJC = ujcs, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
  groups <- sort(unique(summary_table$group))
  
  for (group_name in groups) {
    presence[[group_name]] <- presence$UJC %in% summary_table$UJC[summary_table$group == group_name]
  }
  return(list(presence = presence, group_metadata = group_metadata))
}

get_upset_queries <- function(group_metadata, color_palette) {
  lapply(1:nrow(group_metadata), function(i) {
    set_name <- group_metadata$set[i]
    tech <- group_metadata$technology[i]
    color_val <- color_palette[[tech]]
    upset_query(set = set_name, fill = color_val, color = color_val)
  })
}

# Set-size axis ticks in scientific notation (e.g. 5e+04) to avoid overlapping labels
set_size_scientific <- upset_set_size()
set_size_scientific$scales$scales <- list(scale_y_reverse(labels = scales::label_scientific()))
```

```{r upset_nih}
manifest_file <- "data/UJC/UJC_nih.fofn"
mapping_rules <- c(
  "ont"     = "cDNA_ONT",
  "isoseq"  = "Iso-Seq",
  "masseq"  = "Kinnex"
)
res <- read_dataset(manifest_file, mapping_rules)
presence <- res$presence
group_metadata <- res$group_metadata
groups <- group_metadata$set

p_nih <- ComplexUpset::upset(
  presence,
  intersect = groups,
  name = "UJC",
  height_ratio = 0.5,
  width_ratio = 0.2,
  min_size = 500, # Optimized min_size to 5000 for rapid plot generation
  set_sizes = set_size_scientific,
  matrix = intersection_matrix(
    geom = geom_point(shape = "circle filled", size = 2.0),
    segment = geom_segment(color = "black", linewidth = 0.3)
  ),
  queries = get_upset_queries(group_metadata, color_palette),
  base_annotations = list(
      'Intersection size' = intersection_size(counts = FALSE)
  ),
  themes = list(
    'Intersection size' = theme_nature() + theme(
      axis.text.x = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
      axis.title.x = element_blank()
    ),
    intersections_matrix = list(
      theme_nature() + theme(
        axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        axis.title.y = element_blank()        
      )
    ),
    overall_sizes = list(
      theme_nature() + theme(
        axis.text.y = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
      )
    )
  )
)
```

```{r assemble_all}
# Stack the three UpSet plots vertically for supplementary figure
p_nih_clean <- wrap_elements(p_nih + labs(title = "Mouse") & theme(legend.position = "none"))
p_longbench_clean <- wrap_elements(p_longbench + labs(title = "LongBench") & theme(legend.position = "none"))
p_neuron_clean <- wrap_elements(p_neuron + labs(title = "iNeuron") & theme(legend.position = "none"))

# Stack UpSets vertically in dataset order: NIH / LongBench / Neuron
fig_upset <- (p_nih_clean / p_longbench_clean / p_neuron_clean + 
  plot_layout(heights = c(1, 1, 1))) +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "a")
```

```{r export_fig2}
# Professional high-impact export function
save_pub_r <- function(plot, filename, width_mm = 180, height_mm = 240, dpi = 600) {
  w <- width_mm / 25.4
  h <- height_mm / 25.4
  
  # Lossless Vector SVG
  svglite::svglite(paste0(filename, ".svg"), width = w, height = h)
  print(plot)
  dev.off()
  
  # Vector PDF with embedded fonts
  grDevices::cairo_pdf(paste0(filename, ".pdf"), width = w, height = h, family = "sans")
  print(plot)
  dev.off()
  
  # High-DPI TIFF for publication print
  ragg::agg_tiff(paste0(filename, ".tiff"), width = w, height = h, units = "in", res = dpi)
  print(plot)
  dev.off()
  
  # PNG for rapid preview
  ggsave(paste0(filename, ".png"), plot, width = w, height = h, dpi = 150)
}

save_pub_r(fig_upset, "plots/Supplementary_Figure_6", height_mm = 360)
```
